blocks.html: Pull maps, imagery and data packages into ATAK from your device, or hook up a network link that refreshes itself.

slides.title: Open Import and pick a source
slides.html: Tap the Import icon. In the Select Import Type window choose Local SD, Gallery, KML Link, HTTP URL or Choose App.

slides.title: Import from device storage
slides.html: Pick Local SD, browse to the file and tap OK. ATAK takes config, data packages, elevation data, imagery and overlays; some types prompt you to choose the handler.

slides.title: Choose an import strategy
slides.html: Tell ATAK how to handle the file. Copy duplicates it into the ATAK directory, Move relocates it, and Use in Place leaves it where it is.

slides.title: Add a network link resource
slides.html: Pick KML Link or HTTP URL, enter a Name and the URL, set a refresh interval, then tap Add. The link can auto-refresh and clear local content on shutdown.

slides.title: Download and track remote resources
slides.html:
Added links appear under Remote Resources in Overlay Manager.

  • A red dot means not yet downloaded; tap Download to fetch it.
  • Green means it is in and up to date.
